stemMarkdown: At what rate percent per annum of simple interest will a sum of money become 3 times itself in 10 years? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: To become 3 times itself, the interest earned must be $2$ times the principal. So $\dfrac{P \times R \times 10}{100} = 2P$, giving $R = \dfrac{2 \times 100}{10} = 20.0\%$.
